lines.text: Celebration time! The whole elementary school is cheering for the one hundredth day!
Teacher announces: Each table has five minutes to stack one hundred foam blocks!
At first, everyone scrambled and grabbed blocks, knocking each other's towers over!
Leo called a timeout: If we fight for blocks, nobody wins the trophy!
Mia, you hand the blocks! Sam, steady the wide base! I will place the spire!
Block by block, ten, twenty, fifty, eighty—rising taller than their teacher!
Ninety-nine, ONE HUNDRED! Just as the bell chimed, the golden star crown sat on top!
Teamwork divides the difficult task and multiplies the celebration ten times over!
